title: Bug: LogAnalyzer false positive on dualtor config_reload tests due to journalctl-tagged TACACS+ error
author: gopi-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

After sonic-buildimage PR [#18113](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/18113) migrated rsyslog from UDP to RELP for container-to-host syslog forwarding, transient TACACS+ errors during config reload now appear with the `journalctl:` syslog tag instead of process-specific tags like `audisp-tacplus`, `dockerd`, `ntpd`, etc.

The LogAnalyzer already ignores these same TACACS+ errors from those process-specific tags, but has no pattern for `journalctl:`. Any test calling `config_reload` on a TACACS+ enabled DUT running 202605+ builds will fail on teardown with a false positive.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Use a testbed with TACACS+ authentication configured (e.g. dualtor-AA)
2. Run any test that performs `config reload` on a 202605 build (e.g. `dualtor_io/test_link_failure.py::test_active_link_admin_down_config_reload_upstream`)
3. LogAnalyzer catches transient TACACS+ errors during the networking restart phase.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

 **Actual:** Tests fail on teardown with `Failed: Got matched syslog in processes "analyze_logs"` due to:
`gd377 ERR journalctl: tac_connect_single: connection failed with 172.30.139.229:49: Transport endpoint is not connected`
`gd377 ERR journalctl: nss_tacplus: failed to connect TACACS+ server 172.30.139.229:49, ret=-9: Transport endpoint is not connected`

**Expected:** These transient errors should be ignored, as they are ignored for every other process tag.

### Relevant log output

```shell
- Test: test_active_link_admin_down_config_reload_upstream[active-active]
- Topology: dualtor-aa and dualtor-aa-56

gd377 ERR journalctl: tac_connect_single: connection failed with 172.30.139.229:49: Transport endpoint is not connected
gd377 ERR journalctl: nss_tacplus: failed to connect TACACS+ server 172.30.139.229:49, ret=-9: Transport endpoint is not connected
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
branch.202605-ars.e36dabd7-buildimage.7c11c58c300637d0f925e35a075c920e8a499f96-nightly-2026.06.17.15.48
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

linkedPullRequests.title: Add loganalyzer ignore for journalctl-tagged TACACS+ transient errors
linkedPullRequests.author: gopi-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
During config reload, the NSS TACACS+ module attempts to connect to the TACACS+ server while the network stack is restarting, producing ERR-level syslog messages. The loganalyzer ignore list already covers these errors from ntpd, chronyd, iptables, audisp-tacplus, dockerd, and libnetwork-setkey. In 202605, these errors appear under the 'journalctl:' syslog tag instead of process-specific tags.

The regex matches only "Transport endpoint is not connected" (ENOTCONN), which occurs exclusively when the socket is created but the peer connection was never established — a transient state during service restarts. Real TACACS+ failures produce different errno strings that remain caught by LogAnalyzer.

<!--
Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines;
https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

Please provide following information to help code review process a bit easier:
-->
### Description of PR
Tests calling `config_reload` on TACACS+-enabled DUTs running 202605+ builds fail on teardown with false-positive LogAnalyzer matches:

```
gd377 ERR journalctl: tac_connect_single: connection failed with 172.30.139.229:49: Transport endpoint is not connected
gd377 ERR journalctl: nss_tacplus: failed to connect TACACS+ server 172.30.139.229:49, ret=-9: Transport endpoint is not connected
```

These are transient errors during the networking restart phase of `config reload`. The LogAnalyzer already ignores them from `audisp-tacplus`, `dockerd`, `ntpd`, `iptables`, `chronyd`, and `libnetwork-setkey`. After sonic-buildimage PR [#18113](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/18113) (RELP migration), the syslog tag changed to `journalctl:` which has no ignore pattern.

This fix adds ignore patterns for the `journalctl:`-tagged TACACS+ errors. 175 test files in sonic-mgmt call `config_reload` and are affected.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
sonic-buildimage PR [#18113](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/18113) migrated rsyslog from UDP to RELP for container-to-host syslog forwarding. This changed the syslog tag for host-level TACACS+ transient errors from process-specific names to `journalctl:`. The LogAnalyzer ignore list had no pattern for this tag, causing false-positive teardown failures on all `config_reload` tests with TACACS+ enabled.

The loganalyzer ignore list already covers these errors from ntpd, chronyd, iptables, audisp-tacplus, dockerd, and libnetwork-setkey. 

#### How did you do it?
Added two ignore patterns to `loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt` matching `journalctl:`-tagged `tac_connect_single` and `nss_tacplus` errors with `Transport endpoint is not connected`.

The regex only matches errno=107 (ENOTCONN) which is specific to the "socket not yet ready" transient state during service restarts. Real TACACS+ failures produce different errno strings and remain caught on loganalyzer.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran `test_active_link_admin_down_config_reload_upstream[active-active]` and `test_active_link_admin_down_config_reload_downstream[active-active]` on dualtor-AA testbed with build `branch.202605-ars.e36dabd7`. Both pass teardown with the fix applied.
